status: P4.1 coordinate foundation; interactive authoring still in progress

dependencies.license: MIT alternative; full original dual-license notice retained
dependencies.usage: Use installed vcpkg x64-windows and arm64-android headers: glm/glm.hpp, glm/gtc/matrix_transform.hpp and their transitive headers. Private matrix multiplication, inversion and rotation adapter; no upstream changes or new source vendoring.

design_references.decision: Read selection-scoped transformation and viewport conversion responsibilities. C# operator callbacks/ImGuiNET/System.Numerics/global editor state do not fit our value history contracts; use existing first-party History and GLM adapters. No verbatim source copied.

project_contracts: Canvas-relative pivot/translation, signed scale, clockwise degrees in +Y-down coordinates.
Runtime and editing share the same affine computation. Parent composition and inverse reject singular/nonfinite mappings.
Aspect-fit hit coordinates exclude letterboxes before capture; captured drags can leave the image.
ImGuizmo remains pending: local vcpkg port 1.10 exists, installed project ImGui source is 1.91.9b; compatibility not yet validated.
